carbon_policy_signal.item: Von der Leyen EU strategic gas reserves proposal signals acceptance of winter supply shortfall; implies higher dispatch of coal and LNG if gas constrained, raising EUA demand via merit-order widening and extended coal marginal rate.
carbon_policy_signal.why_it_matters: Strategic reserves move telegraphs EU willingness to burn higher-carbon fuels (coal, gasoil) if gas supply disrupted; shifts merit order and extends coal run-time, raising absolute emissions and EUA compliance need.

freshness_caveat: Coal data 294 days stale (as of 2025-12-26); Clean Dark and Clean Spark 289 days stale (as of 2025-12-31). Live TTF, GB Power, Storage, Renewables, DE Power current as of 2026-10-16. Do not rely on stale coal for merit-order or derived-spread trades without live market cross-check.
risk_flags: GB Power 99th percentile (222.24 EUR/MWh) with renewables at 40th percentile (39.58% of load) — sustained thermal call if wind remains weak.
Storage 14.8pp below 5-yr seasonal norm at 74.14% full; refill pace into winter will determine H2 thermal baseload risk.
Slovakia–Russia rapprochement raises direct TTF upside if gas transit flows constrained or diverted; no quantified timeline yet.
Clean Spark jumped 13.6σ to 32.64 EUR/MWh (89th percentile); metric stale (coal data from Dec 26, 289 days old) — verify with live DA prices before position.

base.summary: Renewables stabilize mid-range; storage refill continues at trend; geopolitical risk priced but not activated.

downside.summary: Wind recovery lifts renewables to 55th+ percentile; storage refill accelerates; EU fiscal intervention announced.

upside.summary: Slovakia gas transit threatened or Russian reroute confirmed; Ukraine refinery strikes spike crude; EU consensus delays.

themes: GB power extremes; renewable output collapsing
EU storage deficit; winter supply risk priced in
Geopolitical upside: Slovakia gas transit, Ukraine refinery strikes
Fragmented EU policy response delays intervention clarity
top_drivers: Renewables collapse (40th percentile, -19.6% 1d) forcing gas/coal + nuclear dispatch; GB Power 99th percentile reflects structural thermal tightness.
Storage 14.8pp below seasonal average; refill trajectory now critical for winter baseload cost — any slowdown reprices TTF upward.
Geopolitical tail-risk: Slovakia–Russia rapprochement + Ukraine refinery strikes create binary TTF upside scenario (supply disruption or rerouting via non-EU allies).
top_takeaway: GB Power at 99th percentile amid tight renewables; Storage 14.8pp below seasonal drives winter risk premium; geopolitical uncertainty (Slovakia–Russia, Ukraine strikes) supports TTF floor.
